audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint findings (MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE) left in place by the propose pass.
audit.why: QA lint pass: pronouns corrected to the enemy champion's gender, duplicated trade lines replaced with field-specific bodies, cooldown fields given real per-rank numbers from champ-data/_kits, magnitude claim backed with a number.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: Shield Vault is a dash, so it feeds your Gloom — pulse W as he lands to fear him, Q the mark, and walk before Aegis Assault turns the trade.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Check it before every step-up. - W Personal Space is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun) is 13s at rank 1: point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up, step up on its downtime. - W Personal Space (16s) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.

notes: QA lint pass: mechanical fixes only.
